questions.question: In the first-order reaction shown, what percentage of reactant A has reacted after 60 min? [Answer in nearest integer]
questions.explanation: t½ = 20 min. At t = 60 min (3 half-lives), fraction remaining = (1/2)³ = 1/8 = 12.5%, so reacted = 87.5%.

distractor_diagnostics.B: Misconception: Evaluated at 2 half-lives (75% reacted) instead of 3 half-lives
